entity.name: Shivam Singh
entity.description: Independent researcher and developer building open-source swarm robotics simulation and control systems. Sole maintainer of Swarm Robotics project (3,640 LOC, 17 tests). Funding supports compute infrastructure, ROS2 integration, and conference travel.

projects.name: Swarm Robotics Simulation
projects.description: Production-grade multi-agent simulation platform for autonomous drone swarms. Features TDMA/D-TDMA communication, packet loss simulation, ghost drone fault tolerance, CBBA task allocation, Reynolds rules, Voronoi partitioning, A/B testing UI, 3D Plotly visualization, Dockerized deployment. 3,640 LOC, 17/17 tests passing. Target: IEEE ICRA 2027.

plans.name: Compute and Benchmarking Infrastructure
plans.description: Dedicated compute server for running the full benchmark suite across 432 configurations with 30+ trials each, generating statistically significant results for IEEE publication.

plans.name: ROS2 Integration and Hardware Path
plans.description: Port CBBA+TDMA logic to ROS2 with Gazebo simulation using Crazyflie/TurtleBot models for hardware validation.

plans.name: ICRA 2027 Conference Travel
plans.description: Travel, accommodation, and registration for ICRA 2027 in Seoul, South Korea (May 24-28, 2027) to present swarm resilience research.

plans.name: Maintainer Time and Sustained Development
plans.description: Sustained funding to support continued development, maintenance, and community support for the Swarm Robotics project.
